title: HVAC Estimate Template
subtitle: A professional estimate pre-filled for HVAC jobs — diagnostic, AC repair, furnace replacement, duct cleaning, maintenance plans and thermostat upgrades. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days of acceptance. Financing options available for system replacements.
notes: Thank you for your business. Estimate valid for 30 days. A 30% deposit is due at signing for equipment replacement; the balance is due upon completion and inspection.
features: Auto-calculating totals in Excel — subtotal, 30% deposit and balance update automatically
Pre-filled HVAC line items: diagnostic, AC repair, furnace replacement, duct cleaning, plans
License # field — most states require an HVAC license on client documents
Valid-until and deposit line built in — standard for equipment quotes

faqs.q: What should I include on an HVAC estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, dated line items (diagnostic, repair, replacement or maintenance), a valid-until date, deposit terms and exclusions. Most states require an HVAC contractor license on client-facing documents.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit and balance automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, 30% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your licensing board and a CPA or attorney before use.
